fusions.name: Skipping Silverside
fusions.desc: Skims a silver dart low over the water at an enemy up to 7 tiles away; it deals 4 damage, rising to 2 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Scattering Shoal
fusions.desc: Looses 4 darting bolts of water from your bow wave in a spread, each one deals 6 damage. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Greased Slipway
fusions.desc: Your dodge chance rises by 25% for 10 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: School in the Wake
fusions.desc: Every attack you dodge adds a stack, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
